lots.title: Inspection & Maintenance of Indoor Gymnasium, Fitness & Sport Equipment and Outdoor Schools Play & Sport Equipment
lots.description: ESPO Framework Agreement reference 107_26 between Leicestershire County Council (trading as ESPO) and an appointed Supplier for the provision of inspection & maintenance of indoor gymnasium, fitness & sport equipment and outdoor schools play & sport equipment services to Customers under the Procurement Act 2023 (PA23). The framework is established as a single non-lotted arrangement; substantive product/service specifications are incorporated from Section 2 (Requirement) of the Invitation to Tender, and commercial pricing is held in Framework Schedule 2 (Charging Structure). Commencement Date is stated as 09 June 2026 (or as otherwise stipulated by ESPO).
requirements: Supplier shall provide Goods and/or Services as specified in Framework Schedule 1 (Goods and/or Services), with substantive specification incorporated from Section 2 of the Invitation to Tender.

Supplier shall comply with the Standards (British Standards produced by BSI Group, international standards, ESPO's internal policies and Government codes of practice referenced in Framework Schedule 1) and the Law when performing its obligations.

Supplier must have Employment Checks in place for Staff, including verification of identity, right to work, registration/qualification, employment history/references, criminal record (DBS) and occupational health checks where applicable.
Where provision of the Goods and/or Services may bring Supplier's employees or volunteers into contact with children and/or vulnerable adults, additional safeguarding checks apply (clause 13.7).
Supplier shall pay a Framework Fee of 3.5% of net turnover, paid in accordance with clause 16 of the Framework Agreement and Framework Schedule 2.
Framework Prices (per Framework Schedule 2) are the maximum Charges payable under any Call-Off Contract; any increase requires objective justification and written agreement of ESPO.
Every 6 months the Supplier shall assess whether Framework Prices can be reduced and report the outcome in writing to ESPO within one Month of each Price Assessment Date.
Supplier shall nominate a Framework Manager as the single point of responsibility, with a suitably qualified deputy, and maintain the framework management structure set out in Framework Schedule 10.

Supplier shall attend Framework Review Meetings with ESPO every 12 Months covering strategic and operational performance (including KPIs, customer satisfaction, new product plans, environmental initiatives).

Supplier shall submit quarterly Management Information (MI) Reports using the ESPO MI Reporting Template by the 5th Working Day after each Quarter, including Nil Returns where applicable, until all Contract transactions cease.
On MI Default ESPO may charge a Default Framework Fee (the higher of the 12-month average Framework Fee or an ESPO-estimated equivalent).

Supplier shall participate in Benchmark Reviews on ESPO's request (not more frequently than every 12 Months) producing a written benchmark report covering rates, methodology, comparators and market intelligence.
Supplier shall adopt a continuous improvement policy and regularly review Goods and/or Services, costs, and efficiency with ESPO.
Supplier shall undertake marketing of the Framework Agreement and Goods and/or Services to Customers in accordance with Framework Schedule 8 (Marketing).

Supplier shall not offer or pay inducements in relation to any tender for Goods and/or Services under the Framework and shall comply with anti-bribery, anti-fraud and conflict-of-interest obligations in clauses 9, 10 and 11.

Supplier shall not increase tendered Framework Prices before the first anniversary of the Commencement Date; subsequent increases are only permitted via the review procedure in Framework Schedule 2 paragraph 3.

evaluation_criteria.criterion: Further Competitive Selection Process Award Criteria
evaluation_criteria.summary: For Call-Off via further competitive selection, Customers apply the Further Competitive Selection Process Award Criteria defined in Framework Schedule 5, typically re-using ESPO's framework evaluation scheme with the option to vary weightings (in particular, increased weighting on price at call-off stage).
evaluation_criteria.weighting_text: Scheme and weightings set per Customer requirement (may increase Price weighting at Call-Off)

evidence_anchor.anchor_text: When evaluating a further competitive selection process, Customers may adopt a scheme similar to that used by ESPO in establishing the Framework or may advise Suppliers that a revised scheme will be used

evaluation_criteria.summary: Call-Off without competition uses the objective mechanism in Framework Schedule 4 paragraph 2.1: (i) select the cheapest Supplier at Framework Prices, or (ii) the only Supplier able to deliver in the geography, or (iii) a Supplier with prior involvement on equivalent Goods/Services in the preceding 12 months where switching would cause demonstrable inefficiencies.

Ongoing performance is monitored quarterly against KPIs in Framework Schedule 10 Annex A: (1) 100% of complaints responded to within 2 Working Days and 98% resolved (or with agreed action plan) within 10 Working Days; (2) at least 3 accurate/on-time Quarterly MI Reports per Contract Year; (3) no more than 1 information-update discrepancy per Contract Year; (4) 98% of invoices accurate in amount each Month; (5) Social Value delivered per Contract and measured/reported.
evaluation_criteria.weighting_text: KPI-based performance monitoring (not a tender scoring weighting)

warnings.message: This document is ESPO 107_26 Appendix A - Framework Agreement, which is the contractual template. Framework Schedule 1 (Goods and/or Services) is itself a placeholder paragraph stating that the substantive Specification will be 'incorporated' from Section 2 (Requirement) of the Invitation to Tender post award. As a result, line-level product/service rate items, per-category inspection scope, pricing and specific BS EN standard numbers are not present in this document and should be sourced from the ITT and Pricing Schedule overlays (pdf-extraction/tender-specification on the ITT document and pdf-extraction/pricing-schedule on Appendix B).
